Title: TemBERTure: advancing protein thermostability prediction with deep learning and attention mechanisms
Summary: Development of TemBERTure, a protein thermostability prediction deep learning system

Title: Enhancing efficiency of protein language models with minimal wet-lab data through few-shot learning
Summary: Developent of Few-Shot Learning for Protein Fitness Prediction, which is notable for its reliance on a minimal labeled dataset for the target protein, comprising merely tens of random single-site mutants

Title: Biophysics-based protein language models for protein engineering
Summary: Development of mutational effect transfer learning (METL), a protein language model framework that unites advanced machine learning and biophysical modeling.

Title: Dynamical Systems–Constrained Metabolic Modeling Enables Forecasting of Host-Microbiome Dynamics
Summary: Introduce the Dynamical Systems Constrained Metabolic Modeling (DySCoMeMo) framework, a new hybrid computational pipeline that integrates ecological DSMs with CBMMs to predict temporal dynamics of biomass and metabolites across microbial communities and hosts

Title: MINN: A metabolic-informed neural network for integrating omics data into genome-scale metabolic modeling
Topic(s): Metabolic modelling-Deep Learning-Metabolic Informed Neural Networks
Summary: Presents a Metabolic-Informed Neural Network (MINN) that utilizes multi-omics data to predict metabolic fluxes in Escherichia coli, under different growth rates and gene knockouts

Title: Artificial intelligence tools for enzyme engineering and metabolic engineering
Summary: This review summarizes recent advances in enzyme redesign using protein language models, de novo enzyme design with generative models, and AI tools for engineering metabolism and related cellular phenotypes

Title: Automation and machine learning drive rapid optimization of isoprenol production in Pseudomonas putida
Summary: Development of a ML-guided DBTL methodology to improve isoprenol production through CRISPR interference

Title: Comparing metabolic engineering scenarios using simulated design-build-test-learn-cycles
Summary: In silico DBTL cycles based on metabolic kinetic models are performed to quantitatively assess how key process parameters affect strain optimization outcomes across four distinct metabolic pathway models.

Title: Comprehensive evaluation of LLM capabilities for interpretation and analysis of genome-scale metabolic models in metabolic engineering
Summary: Systematic benchmark of four leading LLMs (GPT-4, Gemini, Claude, DeepSeek-R1) across four task areas central to metabolic engineering: domain knowledge, metabolic flux prediction, pathway construction, and flux optimization

Title: A systems-level atlas of carbon-response transcriptional states in Escherichia coli
Summary: They use an Escherichia coli transcriptome compendium, together with growth phenotyping and metabolic modeling, and defined 25 carbon-catabolism gene-expression modules (iModulons) and grouped their activities into four substrate-response patterns, providing a quantitative reference for interpreting nutrient-responsive transcriptomes and generating hypotheses about carbon physiology in E. coli.

Title: Integrating Metabolic Networks into Hybrid Bioprocess Models
Topic(s): Metabolic modelling-Deep Learning-Metabolic Informed Neural Networks-Hybrid Metabolic Modelling
Summary: In this study, they introduce FBA-Hyb, a multi-scale hybrid modeling framework that integrates genome-scale metabolic networks via flux balance analysis (FBA) into its architecture

Title: Robust enzyme discovery and engineering with deep learning using CataPro
Summary: Proposed a deep learning model, CataPro, based on pre-trained models and molecular fingerprints to predict turnover number (kcat), Michaelis constant (Km), and catalytic efficiency (kcat/Km)

Title: Pathway engineering for sustainable biomanufacturing: integrating AI, systems biology, enzyme engineering, and dynamic control
Summary: This review highlights recent advances that have transformed pathway engineering from an empirical practice into a predictive and integrated discipline

Title: MeNetModel: A cross-platform engine for enzyme-constrained metabolic modeling and enzyme resource prioritization
Summary: Presents MeNetModel, a cross-platform engine for enzyme-constrained metabolic modeling (ecModels) that extends flux balance analysis with enzyme catalytic and protein allocation constraints for enzyme resource prioritization.

Title: A benchmarking framework for single-cell genome-scale metabolic model construction
Summary: Introduces a benchmarking framework for constructing single-cell genome-scale metabolic models (scGEMs) used to characterize metabolic heterogeneity across cellular states.

Title: Enzyme kinetics shapes the growth response of metabolic networks
Summary: Establishes a metabolic model that integrates local enzyme kinetics and global network architecture to explain how enzyme kinetics shape microbial growth responses.

Title: The Evolution of Standards in Systems Biology: from Metabolic and Multi-Scale to Whole-Cell Models
Summary: Reviews the evolution of standards, formats, and tool ecosystems for mechanistic systems biology models, from metabolic and multi-scale models to whole-cell models.

Title: Integrating Machine Learning and Transcriptomics to Enhance β-Carotene Production in Saccharomyces cerevisiae
Summary: Combines transcriptomic sequencing and machine learning to guide β-carotene production in Saccharomyces cerevisiae.

Title: Expanding the catabolic capacity of Pseudomonas putida to acetovanillone, 5-carboxyvanillate, and vanillyl glyoxylate for muconate production from kraft lignin-derived aromatics
Summary: Expands Pseudomonas putida catabolism of kraft lignin-derived aromatics (acetovanillone, 5-carboxyvanillate, and vanillyl glyoxylate) for muconate production.

Title: Hybrid mechanistic-machine learning models in biosciences: Causality, forecasting, and lab-to-field translation
Summary: Reviews hybrid mechanistic–machine learning models that combine known mechanisms such as stoichiometry and conservation laws with data-driven terms for causality, forecasting, and lab-to-field translation.

Title: GAMclust: identification of regulated metabolic modules in bulk, single cell and spatial gene expression data
Summary: Presents GAMclust, an R package that identifies transcriptionally regulated metabolic modules from bulk, single-cell, and spatial gene-expression data using genome-scale metabolic networks.

Title: Next-Generation Metabolic Models: From Multi-Constraint Integration to AI-Driven Whole-Cell Kinetic Simulation
Summary: Reviews next-generation metabolic models from multi-constraint integration to AI-driven whole-cell kinetic simulation, including flux balance analysis and metabolic pathway analysis.

Title: DigiPhen: a new paradigm for building predictive models of biological systems
Summary: Presents DigiPhen, a digital phenome platform that combines experimental, analytical, and modeling workflows to build multi-scale predictive models of microbial and plant phenotypes.

Title: Application and progress of synthetic biology technology in amino acid production
Summary: Reviews synthetic biology strategies for amino acid production, covering metabolic pathway design, genetic circuits, dynamic regulation, and high-throughput screening.

Title: AlphaGEM enables precise genome-scale metabolic modelling by integrating protein structure alignment with deep-learning-based dark metabolism mining
Summary: Development of AlphaGEM, a versatile toolbox leveraging proteome-scale structural alignment, protein language models (PLMSearch), and deep-learning-based predictions for efficient genomic mining to generate GEMs ready for applications.
